svg.title: Reducing the decision tree to an ROBDD
svg.desc: Four panels. First, the complete decision tree for not-A and B and C with eight leaves. Second, the seven 0 leaves merged into one 0 leaf beside the single 1 leaf. Third, the three C nodes whose edges both reach the 0 leaf merged into one. Fourth, nodes whose two edges lead to the same place removed, leaving three nodes: A, whose 0 edge leads to B and whose 1 edge leads to the 0 leaf; B, whose 1 edge leads to C and whose 0 edge leads to the 0 leaf; and C, whose 1 edge leads to the 1 leaf and 0 edge to the 0 leaf.

g.text: Reducing the decision tree to an ROBDD
Predicate: ¬A ∧ B ∧ C. Each panel applies one reduction rule to the previous one.
